hypothesis: Across the historical fixed design of three independent boots, the exact PROFILE=fidelity tuple with the byte-compatible clean packed-INT6 extension reproduces every frozen runtime non-regression threshold on AIBoss.
falsifier: The median of the three independent boot-level metrics misses any frozen threshold, any functional/identity check fails, any fatal or fallback marker appears, or any owner-service restoration fails.

changed_variables.fixed_measurement: three independent boots matching the historical baseline design

measurement_plan.aggregate: median of the three boot-level medians for numeric metrics
measurement_plan.purpose: candidate-blind exact control recapture; no candidate outputs have been observed

decision_rules.accept: Every identity/function/rollback check passes on every boot and every aggregate numeric metric clears its frozen threshold.
decision_rules.reject: Any boot has an identity/function/rollback failure or any aggregate numeric metric misses its frozen threshold.
decision_rules.abort: Abort only the affected boot on OOM, engine death, live-path mutation, competing GPU process, or timeout; still preserve it and complete remaining preregistered boots when safe.
